name: @caisson/platform-reads
description: Shared typed read-only queries over the services/license cross-service tables (entitlement_grant / license_grant). The buyer dashboard (apps/site) and any other surface that reads these tables import the typed reader here instead of hand-copying raw SQL, so a column rename is a compile/test failure (the columns-contract test) rather than a silent runtime desync. Commercial: it reads commercial services/license table shapes, so it is NOT part of the open Apache Base substrate.
